scripts.build: bun run --cwd ../mirrorr-web build && bun run build:assets
scripts.sync: node scripts/with-mobile-env.mjs "bun run build && cap sync"
scripts.build:android:debug: node scripts/with-mobile-env.mjs "bun run sync && ./android/gradlew -p android assembleDebug"
scripts.build:ios:simulator: node scripts/with-mobile-env.mjs "xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Debug build"
